criteria.criterion: Adhere to extraction constraints (no substitution; exact transcription; no fabrication)
criteria.description: Preserve dates, quantities, punctuation, and wording exactly as returned for the fields that are present, and read values only from the explicitly named arrays/fields requested (do not substitute from Description or ConsumerContact). Full credit if the agent maintains exactness for reported fields and does not fabricate; if data is unavailable/empty/missing, the agent should say so rather than guess. Partial credit for minor formatting/transcription deviations that do not change meaning. No credit for clear fabrication or systematic substitution from disallowed fields.
